description: This PHP file defines a Trait named 'ModelTrait' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Api\V2\Serializer'. The trait provides methods for serializing an entity object into an array, with support for filtering attributes, nested collections, and attribute renaming. It is part of the serialization layer of the OrangeHRM human resource management system, specifically for API version 2.

methods.name: setFilters
methods.description: Sets filters defining which entity attributes should be included in serialization.

methods.name: setAttributeNames
methods.description: Overrides or sets custom attribute names for serialization output.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Assigns the entity object to be serialized.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity object currently set for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the entity to an associative array based on configured filters and attribute names.

methods.name: makeNestedArray
methods.description: Recursively builds multi-dimensional arrays based on nested keys for serialization.

methods.name: normalizeNestedCollection
methods.description: Normalizes a collection of objects into an array of associative arrays using specified getter methods.
